meta.note: General network operating hours are widely reported; exact per-station first/last trains were NOT verified against an official DMRC timetable in this pass.

generalOperatingHours.note: Most lines operate approx. 05:30-23:30. Individual lines/stations vary; some first trains run earlier/later and Sunday first trains often start later.

airportExpress.note: Sources differ: secondary sources cite 04:45 first train; the Airport Express line page (fetched 2026-10-01) says services operate 5:00 am to 11:40 pm from New Delhi as of 2024. Treat exact times as UNVERIFIED - verify with DMRC.

firstLastPerStationNote: Per-station first/last train times: verify with DMRC (delhimetrorail.com / DMRC app) before displaying to users. Do not fabricate station-level timings.
